Name: Cinderella Girls Valley Unofficial English Translation
Author: whipblast
Description:
[size=6]Cinderella Girls Valley Unofficial English Translation[/size]

[size=3]This is an unofficial English Translation of the Cinderella Girls Valley mod.[/size]

[size=3]This is released at this stage so people who want to play the CGV mod in English can, to some degree.[/size]

---------------
[b]HOW TO INSTALL[/b]
1. Download all pre-requisite mods and Cinderella Girls Valley at https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4720 (Cinderella Girls Valley.zip)
2. Drop all files in 8bitCanvas' mod into Stardew Valley/mods
3. Download this mod. (Cinderella Girls Valley ENG.zip)
4. Drop the Unofficial English Translation mod into Stardew Valley/mods
5. Overwrite all.
6. Have fun!
---------------
Once all Marriage lines are translated, this will become the final version 1 file.
---------------

[size=3]If you would like to help translate anything at all, please don't hesitate to message me.[/size]

[b][size=4]About the girls:
[/size][/b]Translation will be 1:1 of the original mod. It is recommended to use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url] mod to find out everyone likes.
[spoiler]
As of 2.5.0, you can now choose what the girls will wear under certain options.
Season -
They will change clothes by the season.
Random -
They will change clothes everyday randomly.
Select -
They will keep the one set of clothes you pick.

To make use of this, please use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
